ai_summary: Aaron Industries Limited has formally notified the NSE and its shareholders about its 13th Annual General Meeting (AGM), scheduled virtually for August 19, 2026, and the availability of its FY 2025-26 Annual Report. This regulatory disclosure ensures compliance with SEBI regulations, providing shareholders with crucial details for e-voting and the record date for a potential final dividend on August 14, 2026. No red flags are apparent, as this is a standard corporate governance and shareholder communication.
